VHist - Interpolate DBL History.vi

Owning Palette: History Report & Utility VIs

The VI inserts the specified timestamp and either interpolated or extrapolated value at this timestamp into an appropriate position in DBL history. Interpolation method can be linear (by default), spline, polynominal or rational.

Click the parameters for more information

 

time stamps. Array of timestamps for respective elements in history data.
history data. Array of historical values.
time stamp (0: now) specifies timestamp to which a new historical value is to be inserted.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
method (linear) specifies a method to determine new value while interpolating or extrapolating.

0linear
1spline
2polynominal
3rational
time stamps out. Array of new timestamps.
history data out. Array of new historical values respective to new timestamps in the time stamps out.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
